items.proposed: no H3K27M selection biomarker (drop B's eligibility row)
items.reason: 'Diffuse midline gliomas, including pediatric-type H3 G34 or E3 K27 mutant tumors' lists one of several allowed diagnoses alongside IDH-wildtype GBM and IDH-mutant astrocytoma; H3 status is not an entry requirement for the trial or for any arm/cohort, so it is not an eligibility or enrichment biomarker.

items.proposed: no IDH selection biomarker (drop B's eligibility row)
items.reason: IDH appears as 'GBM or variants, IDH-wildtype' and 'Astrocytoma, IDH-mutant' - both statuses are eligible, so IDH only defines diagnoses and is not an entry requirement; IDH-wildtype used to define GBM is excluded from any_molecular_selection.
Follows from dropping the IDH and H3K27M rows: the remaining biomarkers (p53, p16, KRAS, PI3K, RRM2) are exploratory correlative only ('will be descriptive in relation to tumor response').

note: Both coders list RRM2 as candidate-matched but exploratory_correlative, so it does not affect candidate_matched_selection. Tumour PK yes from 'peri-tumoral dialysate' and CSF sampling.
